prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Empire C02 sci-fi skill action icon. Create one complete 1254 × 1254 RGBA cutout for exact 48 × 48 runtime, center anchor [24,24].
Reference roles: image 1 is the exact original skill-board cell; preserve its action, orientation and arrangement. Its magenta/white backing and chroma fringe are not artwork. Image 2 is approved chunky sci-fi STYLE ONLY, for thick dark contours, broad matte opaque planes and clear functional materials; do not copy its crate group or add cargo equipment except when the subject explicitly requires a supply case.
Style: exaggerated chunky cartoon proportions, confident dark outline, 2–3 broad cel-shaded values per material, functional ceramic and alloy. Simplify fine panel lines, tiny grooves and highlights for native 48-pixel clarity. No texture noise, scratches, micro-rivets, glossy 3D, photo-real military equipment, neon strips, medieval fantasy or decorative insignia.
Composition: one tightly grouped centered motif with every extremity intact, and at least 8 percent transparent margin on all four sides. No letters, numbers, watermark, logos, badge frame, background disk, ground, scenery, decorative pedestal or cast shadow. Leave clear open transparent gaps between separate parts.
Transparency: genuine alpha-zero background, not painted checkerboard/magenta/white/black. Keep object cores and action glyphs opaque. No broad external glow, halo, aura, bloom, blur, haze, light spill, particle mist or semitransparent glass. Energy and motion cues are clean bounded painted shapes; preserve transparency everywhere outside these purposeful shapes. No alpha keying or cleanup will be performed afterward.
Primary request: Rebuild c02-skill-rescue-dash / 救援冲刺. Preserve exactly TWO unarmed dark graphite/blue-gray spacesuited adults in dynamic rightward running/launching poses, connected by a clearly visible hand-to-hand grasp. The lead rescuer at upper-right reaches their LEFT arm back to hold the trailing person's RIGHT hand at center; the trailing person is lower-left and being helped forward. Keep their two bodies separate except at that single handclasp. Each has one large round helmet with an opaque near-black visor, a thin bounded cyan rim, a compact torso, two distinct bent arms and two clearly readable bent legs. Front person's free arm bends forward to the right; trailing person's free arm bends back to the left. Use broad gray shoulder and knee planes, small functional backpack on the trailing person, no guns or weapons. Preserve the upward-right diagonal motion. Behind and below them, show only THREE broad crisp cyan/ice-blue speed ribbons sweeping left, with dark teal edges and fully transparent gaps, not a shared fog cloud. The source's helping handclasp, both complete silhouettes and clear motion must read at 48px. No third person, child, stretcher, combat strike, aggression, tether chain, abstract arrow, emblems, faces or background.
